summary: July 2026 agronomy visit could not assess yield, manuring, weeding or pruning because the estate supplied no records.
Replanting of ex-P89/P98 (332 ac, PR26) was planted Feb–Jul 2026, but mycorrhizae and Ganoderma sanitation were skipped and weeding is badly delayed.
2025 crop: PA says 4,069.46 t (14.17 t/ha) for Jan–Dec 2025, but that tonnage equals Jan–Sep 2025 in the Agronomy monthly table; the full-year total there is 4,937.92 t (Agronomy states 18.5 t/ha).
2026 manuring had not started by February (0 of 217.05 t) and no records were available in July; production Jan–Feb 2026 was 385.73 t (211.68 + 174.05).
Rats are the main field threat in P21, PR23 and P89/07/13; harvesting intervals have slipped to 16–17 days.

issues.title: 2025 production and yield figures conflict
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 reports FFB 4,069.46 t = 14.17 t/ha for 'January–December 2025, 12 months' (19% below the 5,000 t budget). Agronomy 1/2026 Table 4 monthly production for 2025 totals 4,937.92 t, and the first nine months (Jan–Sep 2025) add up to exactly 4,069.46 t, so the PA tonnage appears to be a Jan–Sep figure labelled as full year (gap 868.46 t = Oct–Dec). Agronomy 1/2026 Table 5 and Agronomy 2/2026 7.1 state 2025 yield 18.5 t/ha (up 5.5% on 17.53 in 2024), but 4,937.92 t over the 287.21 ha mature area is 17.19 t/ha (arithmetic), and 4,681.35 t for 2024 is 16.30 t/ha, which is the PA's last-year figure. The 5.5% rise fits 17.19 vs 16.30, not 18.5 vs 17.53. Appendix 2 of Agro 1/2026 gives 2024 as 6.60 t/ac on 709.7 ac, about 16.3 t/ha. Dashboard shows the figures as stated by each report; the correct full-year t/ha is not stated in either.

issues.title: PA block yields do not match block tonnages
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 17 t/ha column does not equal tonnes / ha: P89+P07+P13 370.46 t / 25.01 ha = 14.81 (shown 16.38); P98 1,525.97/144.47 = 10.56 (shown 11.52); P04 16.66 (shown 18.72); P05 19.73 (21.94); P06 19.70 (22.04); P21 16.43 (18.76). The PA block tonnes add to 4,069.46 t (the Jan–Sep figure above). Agronomy 1/2026 Table 5 gives different 2025 block yields (e.g. P21 19.33, P98 12.52); multiplied by hectares they add to about 4,938 t, matching the Agronomy full-year total. Block yields on this dashboard are the Agronomy Table 5 figures; the PA's last-year column equals Agronomy's 2024 column.

issues.title: Replanting area stated four ways
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 says about 315 acres (127 ha) in 2.2 and 10.1, but 142 ha on the comments page, '351 acres or 142 ha' in 5.7.2 and '315 acres or 217 ha' in 11.1. Agronomy reports say 332 acres; Agronomy 1/2026 4.1.3 writes '332ha, accounting for 44%' (should be acres). Replant hectares left null until the survey is confirmed.

issues.title: Scout harvesting start date conflicts
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 (visit 5 Mar) says immature harvesting of P23 began January 2026; Agronomy 1/2026 (visit 24 Feb) says scout harvesting had not yet started and should begin Q2 2026. Agronomy 2/2026 confirms it has since commenced.

issues.title: 2025 manuring completion conflicts and table totals wrong
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 9 marks P05 rounds 3 and 4 as 69% and 6% and P06 round 3 as 86%; Agronomy 1/2026 marks the same rows 'completed'. Both tables also show P04 round 4 (Oct) as 4.30 of 6.70 t and P98 round 4 as 11.20 of 10.20 t, both marked completed. The PA table rows sum to 183.55 t programmed and 168.42 t applied (91.8%), not the printed 185.53 t and 164.42 t (89%).

issues.title: Worker count inconsistent in PA
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table and 4.1 show 18 workers (ratio 1:19 ha, 22 required); concluding remark 11.3 says the estate has 14 workers at 1 per 13 ha (that ratio is the harvester figure in 4.2).

issues.title: Replanting seedlings and timing
issues.detail: PA 1/2026: about 18,900 seedlings, planting to finish by March 2026. Agronomy 1/2026: 24,000 seedlings to be sourced. Agronomy 2/2026: planting completed July 2026.

issues.title: Housing-project area changed
issues.detail: Agronomy 1/2026: 105 acres in P04 and P98 proposed for housing. Agronomy 2/2026: about 117 acres in P04, P06 and P98.

issues.title: PA text does not match its own tables
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 5.1.3.3 says P89+P07+P13 completed only 1.0 selective round, but Table 7 shows 3.00 rounds (100%); only P98 and P04 show 1.00. PA comments page says the shortfall is 2 harvesters and 2 sprayers, but Table 3 shows -2 harvesters, -1 weeding and -1 mandore.

issues.title: Minor PA arithmetic
issues.detail: Pruning 434.73 of 1,148.84 ha is 37.8%, printed 39%. Palm census table total 303.50 ha vs planted 305.50 ha; census text says 'as of December 2024' under a December 2025 table title.

Consider Electric Badang for mechanised infield collection
Increase sprayers to 3 and field workers to 5; stop glyphosate overspray
Update area statement after survey and redesignate replant as PR26

kb:
LADANG TUMBUK (Tumbok Estate) - Supreme Image Sdn Bhd, Prosper group - FACT PACK
Sources: PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor En. Adnan Bin Mustafa, visit 5 March 2026, review January to December 2025 and January to February 2026, previous visit 18 August 2025); Agronomy Report 2/2026 (Agronomist Mr. Chong Kuan Ming, visit 22 July 2026, follow-up to 24 February 2026); supporting data from Agronomy Report 1/2026 (visit 24 February 2026). Estate Manager En. Zulkifly Bin Nasir (joined estate 1 Oct 2025 from Sri Sisek, replaced En. Mohamad Syukri Bin Ahmad); Senior Manager En. Zulkarnain Bin Barik. Clerk Pn Norhafizah Binti Ahmad appointed 1 November 2025. No newer PA report than 1/2026 and no newer Agronomy report than 2/2026 was found in Drive (checked folder and the 2024, 2025, 2026 subfolders).

AREA (PA 1/2026, Feb 2026, not yet updated for replanting): Title 305.84 ha; planted 305.50 ha; mature 287.21 ha (P89+P07+P13 25.01, P98 144.47, P04 26.71, P05 38.41, P06 32.38, P21 20.23); immature P23 18.29 ha (planted 2023, mature January 2027); buildings 0.34 ha. PA says mature should fall to 160.21 ha after replanting; remaining planted 178.50 ha. Replant area given as about 315 acres (127 ha), elsewhere 142 ha and 217 ha. Agronomy 1 and 2/2026: 332 acres of P98 and P89 replanted, to be redesignated PR26. Agronomy 2/2026: about 117 acres of P04, P06 and P98 proposed for a housing project (Agro 1/2026 said 105 acres in P04 and P98). Agronomy blocking table (acres): P89+P07+P13 61.8, P98 357.0, P04 66.0, P05 94.9, P06 80.0, P21 50.0, PR23 45.2; total 754.9 ac, 31,227 palms. Agro 1/2026: after replanting more than 30% of palms are over 20 years; only 6.6% in prime.
PALM CENSUS (PA, latest): SPH P89+P07+P13 83, P98 84, P04 109, P05 112, P06 118, P21 136, PR23 148; total palms 31,035 (2024) vs 31,227 (2023). Runt palms in P21 not yet marked or removed. Agronomy 2/2026: no palm density update; census still pending.

LABOUR (PA 1/2026, Feb 2026): 18 workers vs 22 required (short 4), all contract; ratio 1:19 ha. Harvesters 14 vs 16, infield collector 1, mature weeding 1 vs 2, manuring 2, mandore 0 vs 1. Single contractor Mugam Enterprise (14 harvesters). With 127 ha felled, harvesters are 1:13 ha and more than adequate, but are being used to plant seedlings. PA wants sprayers raised to 3 and field workers to 5. Agronomy 2/2026: harvester shortage no longer a concern.

HARVESTING: PA - Feb 2026 intervals 15-18 days, 2.0 rounds (P89+P07+P13 16-18, P98 15-17, P04/P05/P06 15-16, P21 16-17). Manual cutter and carrier with wheelbarrows; mechanisation not done; PA suggests renting an Electric Badang from Agrostar (one unit with five harvesters for 178.50 ha). 2025 productivity t/man-day (earnings RM/day): P89+P07+P13 2.44 (73.12), P98 4.36 (152.60, needs verification), P04 2.12 (63.57), P05 1.40 (42.09), P06 1.09 (32.77), P21 1.05 (94.68). Total 2,152 man-days. Harvest rates RM30/t (RM35 P98, RM90 P21). Total harvest and collection cost RM59-60/t tall palms, RM114/t P21. Agronomy 2/2026: intervals slightly over 15 days; over-ripe bunches 5% in P89/07/13 and 4% in P06 at 16/17-day intervals; incomplete loose fruit collection; estate could not provide harvesting interval records. Agronomy 1/2026: over 10% over-ripe in P05.

CROP: PA 1/2026 Table 17 - 'as of December 2025, 12 months' FFB 4,069.46 t = 14.17 t/ha vs budget 5,000 t (17.41 t/ha), 19% below; last year 16.30 t/ha. PA block table (actual t/ha, estimate, last year): P89+P07+P13 16.38 (15.99, 14.74); P98 11.52 (13.84, 12.98); P04 18.72 (22.46, 23.14); P05 21.94 (23.43, 23.15); P06 22.04 (24.71, 23.54); P21 18.76 (14.83, 8.30). PA block tonnes: 370.46, 1,525.97, 444.99, 757.67, 637.93, 332.44 (printed t/ha do not equal tonnes divided by hectares: 14.81, 10.56, 16.66, 19.73, 19.70, 16.43).
Agronomy 1/2026 Table 4 monthly FFB (t) 2024 / 2025: Jan 364.16/290.64; Feb 384.34/307.86; Mar 465.47/400.35; Apr 464.55/478.39; May 488.43/554.08; Jun 413.40/544.06; Jul 399.44/583.30; Aug 448.47/469.19; Sep 343.25/441.59; Oct 323.88/329.54; Nov 284.65/292.07; Dec 301.31/246.85; total 2024 4,681.35 t, 2025 4,937.92 t. 2026: Jan 211.68, Feb 174.05, total 385.73 t. Production declining since July 2025, attributed to felling of palms (Agro says 332 ha, 44% of fields; 332 is acres elsewhere).
IMPORTANT RECONCILIATION: the first nine months of 2025 (Jan-Sep) in Agro Table 4 add up to exactly 4,069.46 t, the PA's 'Jan-Dec 2025' figure. So the PA figure appears to cover Jan-Sep 2025 only; the full-year 2025 tonnage is 4,937.92 t (Oct-Dec = 868.46 t). Agronomy 1/2026 Table 5 (full year 2025 vs 2024, t/ha): P89/07/13 19.28 vs 14.74 (+30.8%); P98 12.52 vs 12.98 (-3.5%); P04 19.63 vs 23.14 (-15.2%); P05 24.62 vs 23.15 (+6.3%); P06 24.26 vs 23.54 (+3.1%); P21 19.33 vs 8.30 (+132.9%); estate 18.5 vs 17.53 (+5.5%) on 287.21 ha. These block yields multiplied by hectares add to about 4,938 t. However 4,937.92 t / 287.21 ha = 17.19 t/ha (not 18.5) and 4,681.35 t / 287.21 ha = 16.30 t/ha (not 17.53; 16.30 is the PA's last-year figure). The 5.5% rise fits 17.19 vs 16.30. Neither report states a corrected full-year t/ha; treat 18.5 as stated by Agronomy but doubtful. PA budget for 2025 was 5,000 t (17.41 t/ha).
Agronomy 1/2026 comments: P98 lowest at 12.5 t/ha (low density, severe Ganoderma); P89/07/13 improved with better crop recovery, particularly P13; P21 expected to exceed 22 t/ha in 2026; P04 fell from 23 to nearly 20 t/ha through incomplete crop recovery and under-pruning; P05 and P06 above 24 t/ha. Long-term (Agro 1 Appendix 2, t/acre): 2012 peak 12.1; 2016 7.27; 2020 8.21; 2021 7.34; 2022 5.55; 2023 6.30; 2024 6.60 (709.7 ac, 4,681.35 t). Agronomy 2/2026 (22 Jul 2026) 7.1-7.2: 2025 yield 18.5 mt/ha (+5.5%); 2026 field yields could not be assessed because the estate gave no yield data or progress report. No 2026 year-to-date t/ha is stated in either report.

MANURING: PA 1/2026 - 2025 programme 185.53 t, applied 164.42 t (89%), declared complete after revision; P05 rounds 3/4 69% and 6%, P06 round 3 86%. 2026 programme 217.05 t (Mix B 175.25, RP 30.25, compound 11.55); none received or applied by February. Agronomy 1/2026 - 2025 completed but over two months late for many rounds; P23 April compound applied in December (eight months late, needs verification); 2026 programme revised for higher prices. Agronomy 2/2026 - H1 2026 manuring records not furnished, progress unknown. 2027 programme (Agro 2/2026, kg/palm): P89/07/13 Mix B 2.00 x4 plus RP 1.50; P98 NK1 2.00 x2 (withdraw if replanted); P04, P05, P06 Mix B 2.25 x4 plus RP 1.50; P21 Mix B 2.00 x4 plus RP 2.00; PR23 Mix B 1.75 x4 plus RP 2.00; PR26 Compound 0.80, 0.90, 1.00, 1.00 plus RP 1.50. New planting: 600 g CRF and 500 g RP per hole. Revised 2026 programme (Agro 1/2026) e.g. P04 NK1 2.25, Mix B 2.25, RP 1.50, Mix B 1.50; P21 Mix B 1.75/1.50 and RP 1.75; PR23 Mix B 1.50 and RP 2.00.

WEEDING: PA - 2025 circle spraying 908.08 of 993.54 ha (2.97 rounds, 91%); P04 67%, P21 60%, P23 80%. Selective 533.68 ha (54%); P98 and P04 1 round of 3, P21 1 of 5. Jan-Feb 2026: only P23 circle (18.29 ha); no selective. Glyphosate overspray on inter-rows criticised; recommends Triclopyr plus Ally or sodium chlorate. Agronomy 2/2026: records not provided; vegetation generally acceptable, Nephrolepis dominant; VOPs in P04/P06; over-spraying in P06; Nephrolepis encroachment in P89; large epiphytes in P05/P06; Stenochlaena patches.

PRUNING: PA - 2025 434.73 of 1,148.84 ha (1.5 of 4 rounds, printed 39%); under-pruning in P04, P05, P06. Agronomy 2/2026 - no records; P04 backlog cleared; P06 still under-pruned; pruning on hold in development areas; P89 tall palms unattended.

PESTS AND DISEASE: PA - no major rat or bagworm issues; rat census every 3 months advised. Agronomy 2/2026 - significant rat damage in P89/07/13; P21 and PR23 rat attack continues despite two baiting rounds; Ganoderma spreading (P04), annual census recommended, none done; Apogonia in replant reduced after cypermethrin; rat-killed replant palms supplied.

YOUNG AND IMMATURE (Agronomy 2/2026): PR21 (ex-P96, 50 ac) second harvesting year; crop recovery suboptimal; over-pruning, fronds in circles, bare ground, long frond butts. PR23 (45.20 ac) scout harvesting commenced, over-pruning, sporadic weeds; mature from 2027.
REPLANTING (PR26): Land prep Dec 2025-Feb 2026 with cambered bunds (CECT concept per PA); planting Feb-Jul 2026 at 148 palms/ha (29 ft triangular); seedlings from Juasa, Cheekah Kemayan, Muar; PA estimated 18,900 seedlings, planting at RM1.50/palm. Ploughing/harrowing for Ganoderma not done; mycorrhizae 500 g/palm not applied; 600 g CRF and 500 g RP per hole applied; banana intercrop so no legume cover; weeding badly delayed.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA): backhoe 72 hours at RM68.75/hr = RM4,950; 390 t crusher run budgeted at RM32/t, none used. Drainage satisfactory.
VEHICLES (PA): Toyota Hilux WB 472 H and Mazda 1-ton lorry WGK 6856, fair condition; running costs monitored by HQ.
RAINFALL (Agronomy 1/2026): 2021 1,548 mm/68 days; 2022 2,241/77; 2023 2,101/97; 2024 1,388/88; 2025 2,618/161.
COST OF PRODUCTION: neither report contains general charges, upkeep cost or cost-per-tonne tables.

ffbProd.notes: PA 1/2026 (5 Mar 2026) states 4,069.46 t / 14.17 t/ha 'as of December 2025, 12 months' and PA Tables 15/17 repeat it; that figure equals Jan-Sep 2025 of Agro Table 4 (290.64+...+441.59 = 4,069.46), so it is NOT a full year and is excluded. Full 2025 = 4,937.92 t (Agro Table 4 total; Oct 329.54, Nov 292.07, Dec 246.85 add 868.46). Agro 1/2026 and 2/2026 quote 18.5 t/ha for 2025 (+5.5% vs 17.53 in 2024); area basis differs from PA (287.21 ha mature). Agro 1/2026 Appendix 2 lists 2006-2024 annual tonnes; no 2025 row there. 2024 Appendix 4,681.35 matches Table 4 monthly sum. 2026: only Jan-Feb printed (note Agro says 2026 yield stats 'not accurately presented'); production fell from late 2025 owing to felling ~332 ac (127-142 ha) for replanting. PA 1/2026 has no 2026 tonnage. Agro 2/2026 (22 Jul 2026) states estate gave no yield data, so no Mar-Jun 2026 figures exist. 2026 Jan-Feb includes mature fields only; PR23 scout harvesting began Jan 2026 per PA (Agro 2/2026 also says commenced), not stated whether included. Monthly sum 2024 = 4,681.35; 2025 = 4,937.92.
